udalosti.titulek: Wuhan reports a cluster of pneumonia cases
udalosti.detail: Health officials in Wuhan, China, report pneumonia cases of unknown cause. WHO's office in China picks up their statement the same day.

zdroje.nazev: Pneumonia of unknown cause - China (Disease Outbreak News)
Listings of WHO's response to COVID-19

udalosti.titulek: Genome of the new coronavirus is released online
udalosti.detail: A consortium led by Zhang Yongzhen of Fudan University, Shanghai, releases the genome on virological.org.

zdroje.nazev: Novel 2019 coronavirus genome
zdroje.vydavatel: Virological.org (post by Edward C. Holmes for the consortium led by Yong-Zhen Zhang)

udalosti.titulek: China halts all transport in and out of Wuhan
udalosti.detail: From 10:00 on 23 January 2020, all transport into and out of Wuhan is banned, and the ban is then extended to the whole of Hubei Province.

zdroje.nazev: An investigation of transmission control measures during the first 50 days of the COVID-19 epidemic in China
zdroje.vydavatel: Science (Tian H. et al.), via PubMed Central

udalosti.titulek: WHO declares a global health emergency (PHEIC)
udalosti.detail: On the advice of its Emergency Committee, WHO's Director-General declares the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

zdroje.nazev: Statement on the second meeting of the International Health Regulations (2005) Emergency Committee regarding the outbreak of novel coronavirus (2019-nCoV)
Listings of WHO's response to COVID-19

udalosti.titulek: WHO names the disease COVID-19
udalosti.detail: WHO announces the name COVID-19. Under agreed rules, it avoids places, animals, people and groups, to prevent inaccurate or stigmatizing names.

zdroje.nazev: WHO Director-General's remarks at the media briefing on 2019-nCoV on 11 February 2020
Listings of WHO's response to COVID-19

udalosti.titulek: WHO characterizes COVID-19 as a pandemic
udalosti.detail: WHO's Director-General says COVID-19 can be characterized as a pandemic, citing over 118,000 cases in 114 countries and 4,291 deaths.

zdroje.nazev: WHO Director-General's opening remarks at the media briefing on COVID-19 - 11 March 2020

udalosti.titulek: First treatment shown to cut deaths in severe COVID-19
udalosti.detail: Early results of a UK trial show the steroid dexamethasone cuts deaths by about a third in ventilated patients and a fifth in those on oxygen.

zdroje.nazev: WHO welcomes preliminary results about dexamethasone use in treating critically ill COVID-19 patients

udalosti.titulek: Deaths in the WHO data pass 1 million
udalosti.detail: In the current WHO data, which is revised over time, reported COVID-19 deaths add up to more than 1,000,000 by this week.

zdroje.nazev: WHO COVID-19 dashboard: weekly reported cases and deaths

udalosti.titulek: UK authorises the Pfizer/BioNTech vaccine
udalosti.detail: UK regulator MHRA gives the Pfizer/BioNTech vaccine temporary emergency approval, the first such approval to follow an international Phase 3 trial.

zdroje.nazev: UK medicines regulator gives approval for first UK COVID-19 vaccine
zdroje.vydavatel: GOV.UK (Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency)

zdroje.nazev: An update on the coronavirus vaccine, 2 December 2020
zdroje.vydavatel: GOV.UK (Department of Health and Social Care)

zdroje.nazev: First Authorization in the World for a COVID-19 Vaccine Issued in UK for Pfizer and BioNTech Vaccine

udalosti.titulek: UK begins vaccinating with the Pfizer/BioNTech vaccine
udalosti.detail: Margaret Keenan, 90, receives the Pfizer/BioNTech vaccine at University Hospital Coventry, the first dose of the UK's rollout.

zdroje.nazev: UK marks one year since deploying world's first COVID-19 vaccine

udalosti.titulek: UK reports a new variant, later named Alpha
udalosti.detail: The UK tells WHO about variant VOC 202012/01 (B.1.1.7), traced back to Kent in September 2020. Early data suggest it spreads more easily.

zdroje.nazev: SARS-CoV-2 Variant - United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland (Disease Outbreak News)
SARS-CoV-2 Variants (Disease Outbreak News)

udalosti.titulek: South Africa reports a new variant, later named Beta
udalosti.detail: South Africa announces variant 501Y.V2 (B.1.351), first identified in Nelson Mandela Bay. Within weeks it dominates three provinces.

zdroje.nazev: SARS-CoV-2 Variants (Disease Outbreak News)

udalosti.titulek: WHO lists its first COVID-19 vaccine for emergency use
udalosti.detail: WHO validates the Pfizer/BioNTech vaccine for emergency use, so countries can speed up their own approvals and UNICEF and PAHO can buy it.

zdroje.nazev: WHO issues its first emergency use validation for a COVID-19 vaccine and emphasizes need for equitable global access

udalosti.titulek: Japan reports a new variant found in travellers from Brazil
udalosti.detail: Japan notifies WHO of a variant found by whole-genome sequencing of samples from travellers from Brazil.

zdroje.nazev: Listings of WHO's response to COVID-19

udalosti.titulek: Deaths in the WHO data pass 2 million
udalosti.detail: In the current WHO data, which is revised over time, reported COVID-19 deaths add up to more than 2,000,000 by this week.

zdroje.nazev: WHO COVID-19 dashboard: weekly reported cases and deaths

udalosti.titulek: COVAX rollout begins with vaccine delivery to Ghana
udalosti.detail: 600,000 AstraZeneca/Oxford doses made by the Serum Institute of India land in Accra, the first COVAX delivery to a country outside India.

zdroje.nazev: COVID-19 vaccine doses shipped by the COVAX Facility head to Ghana, marking beginning of global rollout
Listings of WHO's response to COVID-19

udalosti.titulek: WHO announces B.1.617 as a variant of concern
udalosti.detail: WHO upgrades lineage B.1.617, first identified in India, to a variant of concern.

zdroje.nazev: COVID-19 Virtual Press conference transcript - 10 May 2021

udalosti.titulek: WHO gives variants Greek letter names
udalosti.detail: WHO introduces easy-to-say Greek letter labels such as Alpha and Delta, to discourage stigmatizing names based on where variants were found.

zdroje.nazev: WHO announces simple, easy-to-say labels for SARS-CoV-2 Variants of Interest and Concern

udalosti.titulek: Deaths in the WHO data pass 5 million
udalosti.detail: In the current WHO data, which is revised over time, reported COVID-19 deaths add up to more than 5,000,000 by this week.

zdroje.nazev: WHO COVID-19 dashboard: weekly reported cases and deaths

udalosti.titulek: WHO names Omicron a variant of concern
udalosti.detail: Two days after South Africa reports variant B.1.1.529 to WHO, WHO designates it a variant of concern and names it Omicron.

zdroje.nazev: Classification of Omicron (B.1.1.529): SARS-CoV-2 Variant of Concern

udalosti.titulek: WHO estimates 14.9 million excess deaths
udalosti.detail: WHO estimates about 14.9 million excess deaths (range 13.3 to 16.6 million) linked to the pandemic in 2020 and 2021.

zdroje.nazev: 14.9 million excess deaths associated with the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020 and 2021

udalosti.titulek: China drops key zero-COVID rules
udalosti.detail: China's 10 new measures cut mass testing, end test and health code checks in most public places, and let mild cases isolate at home.

zdroje.nazev: China optimizes COVID-19 policies
zdroje.vydavatel: The State Council of the People's Republic of China (english.www.gov.cn, article from chinadaily.com.cn)

zdroje.nazev: No new COVID variants emerged during China's recent outbreak (press release on a Lancet study)

udalosti.titulek: WHO ends the COVID-19 global health emergency
udalosti.detail: WHO's chief declares COVID-19 over as a global health emergency. Almost 7 million deaths were reported to WHO; he puts the true toll at 20 million or more.

zdroje.nazev: Statement on the fifteenth meeting of the IHR (2005) Emergency Committee on the COVID-19 pandemic
WHO Director-General's opening remarks at the media briefing - 5 May 2023

udalosti.titulek: Deaths in the WHO data pass 7 million
udalosti.detail: In the current WHO data, which is revised over time, reported COVID-19 deaths add up to more than 7,000,000 by this week.

zdroje.nazev: WHO COVID-19 dashboard: weekly reported cases and deaths

udalosti.titulek: Fewer and fewer countries still report
udalosti.detail: In the last 12 weeks of the data, about 60 countries and territories reported to WHO each week, down from 231 at the peak.
